## One Last, Much Harder Problem

Here's a genuine Olympiad-level puzzle to finish on — the kind that punishes a shortcut answer.

Submit what you think the answer is first. Only then will the full step-by-step solution unlock, so you actually commit to a guess before seeing why it's right or wrong.

**Nothing here needs more than the arithmetic you already have — just more careful thinking about what 'total distance' actually means, moment to moment.**
